findings.title: Multi-proof-path last-writer-wins guard aggregation
findings.body: _scan_artifacts overwrites guards.self_certification_status (and live_write_status, merge_seam_status) per proof file with no aggregation across multiple proof_paths; an incomplete proof listed before a complete one has its UNKNOWN silently overwritten. Auditor empirically confirmed this is pre-existing on the parent commit (which was strictly worse: it also passed on complete-then-empty ordering) and is strictly improved, not introduced, by this commit. Out of scope for F001/F002 (single-proof identity classification); recommended as a follow-up finding (e.g. DMX-W1-04-F003).

findings.title: Pre-existing UNKNOWN->PRESERVED/NONE guard normalization outside this diff
findings.body: red_lane_scanner.py lines ~245-271 (untouched by this commit) convert merge_seam_status, dopetask_execution_status, external_write_status, and github_mutation_status from UNKNOWN to PRESERVED/NONE purely on absence of specific finding categories, which is the same invariant-6 pattern as F001 but for different guards.
